task: Asha stores the marks like this. What kind of value is marks?

options.why: 12.0 has a decimal point, so it is a decimal (float), not a whole number.
12.0 has no quotes, so it is not text.

options.text: It cannot be known until it is printed
options.why: The kind is fixed by how the value is written, before anything is printed. 12.0 is written with a decimal point.

ok: 12.0 is a decimal (float): the decimal point makes it a decimal, even though it ends in .0.
